title: Guard deleteService against any name outside the qualify prefix
summary: One-line guard so scripts/qualify-packaged.ts deleteService refuses a name without the opum.ward.qualify- prefix.
description: opum-doc NIT on #157: deleteService deletes every credential-store item under a service by name. Today both callers pass qualify-prefixed services, but nothing stops a later caller passing opum.ward. Add a guard inside deleteService that throws for any name not beginning opum.ward.qualify-, and a test or a check that proves the refusal (a positive control that a qualify name is accepted). Low priority; found in the WCLI-15 review, no re-review needed.
plan: Move deleteService into scripts/qualify-cleanup.ts with an exported guard that throws for any name not beginning opum.ward.qualify-, and an injectable runner so the guard is testable without a keychain; qualify-packaged.ts imports it.

Add test/qualify-cleanup.test.ts: refusal for opum.ward and prefix lookalikes without invoking /usr/bin/security, and the positive control that a qualify-prefixed name is accepted and drives the runner.
Run bun run check and lore check, commit, and open a pull request into dev.
implementationNotes: deleteService now lives in scripts/qualify-cleanup.ts with a guard that throws for any service not beginning opum.ward.qualify-, plus an injectable runner. The move is what makes the guard testable: qualify-packaged.ts exits on import unless it is a macOS run with WARD_QUALIFY_REAL_KEYCHAIN=1, so a test cannot import it where it stood. test/qualify-cleanup.test.ts proves refusal for opum.ward and prefix lookalikes with the runner never called, and the positive control that a qualify service is accepted and drives the runner. Full bun run check: 773 tests pass, lint/format/layer/eval/reserved clean; lore validate --strict and check-lore-agent-sources clean. Out of scope, reported: scripts/qualify-packaged.ts imports createSqliteVaultStore and never uses it (pre-existing on dev, line 46).
